newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish 96 grain output falls to 24.7 mln tonnes.
newsitem.headline: Polish 96 grain output falls to 24.7 mln tonnes.

text.p: Poland produced 24.7 million tonnes of grains in 1996, 900,000 tonnes less than in 1995, the Central Statistical Office (GUS) said in an output estimate report on Tuesday.
The estimate puts this year's total grain output 200,000 tonnes lower than the last one in September, which GUS said was due to losses caused by unfavourable weather during harvest.
GUS said Poland produced 6.98 million tonnes of winter wheat in 1996 against 6.97 million in 1995, and 1.53 million tonnes of spring wheat against 1.70 million in 1995.
The report said production of rye this year was 5.61 million tonnes against 6.29 million last year.
Winter barley output fell to 555,000 tonnes from 726,000 in 1995, while spring barley production rose to 2.86 million tonnes from 2.55 million last year.
